_questSeedsWhy: ⚑ SNG-167 §2 — an errand this person would ASK for, drawn from their own `wants` and `fears`. ⚠️ Authored with the champion because the ratchet caught eight new people carrying a want and no seed, which is exactly what it is for. ⛔ A coliseum champion is not only an opponent — 'the memorable arcs start with someone'.
_tierWhy_20260908: ⛔ AN AUTHORED TIER, BECAUSE THE DERIVATION'S CEILING IS `heroic` AND THESE ARE AT OR ABOVE IT. ⚑ CCode 2026-09-08: 'a derivation must never mint a legendary — a REGEX IS NOT ENTITLED TO MAKE THAT CLAIM', and the corollary is that ANY BEING ABOVE HEROIC MUST CARRY THE FIELD. ⚠️ AND THE DERIVATION WOULD HAVE BEEN WRONG IN BOTH DIRECTIONS HERE: `warden` derives REGIONAL, so `veth_ondra` — L33, 24 crafts, THE HIGHEST-LEVEL AUTHORED PERSON IN THE VALLEY — would have been demoted three rungs. ⛑ Their authored `level` was protecting them and only by accident; a level and a tier are two fields and both should say the same thing. ⚑ HERE: ⚑ Coliseum champion of the SUSTAIN cell, L27, 'six hours, twice.' ⛔ Above the heroic floor of 25 and her role reads 'champion' — which DOES derive heroic, but she is a named cell-holder and epic is the honest rung.
_tierCorrection_20260908: ⛑ CORRECTED THE SAME HOUR. AEVI ASSIGNED `epic` ON VIBES AND THE FLOOR TABLE SAYS OTHERWISE: `tierFloor` reads riffraff 1 · notable 5 · regional 12 · HEROIC 25 · EPIC 40 · legendary 60 · mythic 85. ⛔ EVERY ONE OF THESE SIX IS L25–33 — squarely the HEROIC band, and epic begins at 40. ⚠️ AND THE GATE CAUGHT THE CONSEQUENCE, NOT THE ERROR: §107 asserts the presence cadence is ORDERED and roughly at Erik's rates — 'a heroic about weekly, an epic about fortnightly'. Six wrong epics pushed epics to OUTNUMBER heroics 59 to 55, and both collapsed to weekly. ⛑ A tier is not a compliment; it is a rung with a level attached, and the level was already authored and already right.
